senses.gloss:
कोविद को-विद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. को and rt.
विद्, to know), experienced, skilled, learned, wise
(with loc., gen., and at the end of comp., e. g. अश्वेषु
or अश्वानाम् or अश्व-कोविद, skilled in horses).

कोविदार को-विदार, अस्, m. a tree, Bauhinia
Variegata; also one of the trees of paradise.
